title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I saw a dream My Sheikh Who is well known Dayee working hard to Introduce Islam among non Muslims at new delhi railway station.I met him conveyed salam to him.He told you bring a taxi for markaz Nizamuddin.I tried my best but unable to get taxi.In the meanwhile I met my one of the friend.He asked what is the matter. I told that Maulana who isIs daur ka sabse Allah ka chaheta banda station per hai chalo tum bhi milo.we went back to see hazrat maulana but we found him giving dawa to coolies on outside of railway station. We turned back to hire taxi for markaz but in vain.Previously I was working with jamate tablighue actively but nowadays I am working among nonmuslims only due to persional disputes with my local tablighy sathies. Please convey the tabeer of khwab to me please? 2761 views Q. But still so often I used to see flying Kites and catching Kites with long string (patang ki Dore)in my Dreams (Khuab). what does it mean? please guid me. 1920 views Q. Assalaamu 'Alaikum, A long time ago, a woman had a dream that her dead father is telling her to tell her husband to cut a tree (he indicated which tree it is) that is at their backyard. She told her husband this but her husband said that he cannot cut it and so it wasn't cut. What is the meaning of that dream? Should her husband have cut it? Please answer in English as soon as possible. Jazakallah khairan wassalaamu 'alaikum. 1354 views Q. Dream 1686 views Q. Dream 1591 views Q. Assalam aly kum Dear Mufti Saab, may Allah shower his blessings on u and my brothers and sisters. I have seen a Dream few days ago. In mY dream i m traveling with my close cousin brother in a bus some one teases me there i get angry and go and sit in front seats of the bus after a while i get down and i miss the bus, and i realize it time for magrib namaz so i see myself on a road which i see usually in my dreams in am standing there and one of my small cousin comes there and i give him my bag and tell him keep the bag and cum soon for namaz then i start going for namaz. on the road i see some people having beard and wearing caps i m not able to see their faces. they call me and one of them ask me were r u going, i say for namaz he says sit with me, i say i have to go to namaz i m getting late again he say sit with me i say i have to go to namaz then he says me namaz is not necessary for u as u r innocent but i dont listen to him and start going he catches my jubba i see at him with anger and say u shaitan jinn and punch him on his face,then i woke up. Do answer me what this dreams means take care. 1340 views Q. Assalam o Alaikum Warahmatullahe Wabarakatuhu Mofti sahb, I am in circumstances where I have to take some very important decision. The situation is that I am living in Dubai, UAE with my family. I got married in 2007 and Allah Blessed me with a daughter this year. My wife, daughter and mother all live with me here in Dubai. My father was died long back and I am taking care of my mother. As you know, due to increasing inflation it is very difficult to save some money. I could not save any single dirham for last two years since when I came here in dubai.and also sometime a satuation come that it becomes very difficylt to pass the month in my earning So I am thinking whether to keep my family here with me and keep living without saving any money and just trust on Allah that situation will get better or if I send my family back home (Pakistan), I can save reasonable amount every month. So before making the final decision, I decided to do ''Istikhara'' as sunnah. Yesterday night, I abolute and offered two nawaffil and then recite dua for correct guidance from Allah SWT and then slept without talking to anybody. I saw a dream that I want you to give me ''tabeer'' for. I saw that I am standing by a closed grave which is made of white marble (and I felt in dream that this is my own grave). I am dusting the grave and I am saying to my wife with so much grief that how would you live without me (meaning that when I will go into the grave). That''s it. I don''t know whether this dream is meaningful or not. Or it has any connection with ''Istikhara'' but I simply request you to please guide me on this. Jazakumullaho khair. 1489 views Q. As you aware better the situation of Afghanistan Here in Afghanistan i am working with Afghan government as an Official. but our scholars says that working with current government is prohibited in Islam but some of the scholars says that no problem you can work with government please advice me that what is islam says about this. Now my mother has done Istikhara for one week, last two days she had dreams, 6th Day dream: My mohter saw two girls and two boys and one of the boy is my younger brother. 7th Day dream: My mother saw some male and female members in white clothes collectively performing zikr along with my Qala. Can you please interpret this dream and guide me further in this regard. 1612 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 46135 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Dream Question: I have been looking for jobs over a year and could not find one. So I decided to do istikharah whether I should migrate to some nearby country or other city within Saudi Arabia in search of jobs (OR) If I should go elsewhere to pursue my career by doing masters and trying my luck in those other countries. I did istikharah two times. Both the dreams I saw after praying Fajr. First night’s dream: I saw I am in Makkah and I felt like it is my home town and I saw some of my British friends over there. I was happy to see them revert to Islam but upon asking them they told me they came as tourist and didn't revert to Islam! It was really unpleasant dream. Second dream: In dark night I saw a crow flying from far and landing straight on my finger and I was feeding it. It would not leave me even if I tried to throw it away. It was glued to my fingers. But then I got rid of it. After I saw a white beautiful dove diving into my laps and I was trying to get it out. Answer ID: 46135 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 971/755/H=1434) Ma-shaAllah both the dreams are nice and they indicate that you should stay in Saudi Arabia and look for any suitable job, it shall be good for you, in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
